edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It governs your forward steps. - W Personal Space spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140/110/80s: point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It governs your forward steps. - His Q silence cycles every 6s flat, so poke between casts. - Your W (16s at rank 1) spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: The mark makes your next Q a fear on hit — fire it down the marked line the moment the glow is up, before his 6s Q silence comes back to deny the cast.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Void Shift eats your first hit for free — poke that lands into the intact passive is wasted mana, and his 6s Q silence punishes the follow-up you queued behind it.

edits.before: Level 6 is Vex-favoured because you can interrupt or QSS Nether Grasp then burst.
edits.after: Level 6 is Vex-favoured: QSS breaks Nether Grasp, and you burst him after baiting Void Shift.

edits.before: Shadow Surge (R) can interrupt his Nether Grasp (R) channel and, more importantly, your movement-slow passive plus QW combo bursts him before he can fully suppress-combo you.
edits.after: Shadow Surge (R) finishes him from missile range after a marked trade, and your fear plus QW combo bursts him before he closes to the 700 range Nether Grasp (R) needs.

edits.before: With 2+ items you delete him from Fear range; just carry QSS or Cleanse timing so his ult can't chain your death.
edits.after: With 2+ items you delete him from Fear range; carry QSS — Cleanse cannot break suppression — so his ult can't chain your death.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you out-poke him hard; his only kill pattern is landing Nether Grasp (R) point-blank, so hold Shadow Surge or a summoner to break it and burst him after baiting Void Shift.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you out-poke him hard; his only kill pattern is landing Nether Grasp (R) at 700 range, so keep QSS or Flash spacing for the suppress and burst him after baiting Void Shift.

edits.before: With items you win the solo kill through Fear burst, but the matchup is really about his suppress ult, so itemize Cleanse or QSS timing to flip his all-in.
edits.after: With items you win the solo kill through Fear burst, but the matchup is really his suppress ult — buy QSS (Cleanse does not remove suppression) to flip his all-in.

edits.before: Track his ult and interrupt or QSS it
edits.after: Track his ult and hold QSS for the suppress
